description: Explore Tarot and Western astrology in ChatGPT. Astera can calculate natal charts, synastry, Solar Returns, lunar guidance, and personal horoscopes, and can draw Tarot cards and spreads. Some readings include interactive visual results. Users may optionally sign in to an existing Astera account to access features already included in their Premium entitlement. Readings are interpretive and intended for reflection or entertainment, not as medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.

defaultPrompt: What does my birth chart say about me?
